# DevCodex Privacy Policy

## Data collection
DevCodex **does not collect any user data**. All sessions, character cards, settings and workspace files are stored locally on your device (in the app private directory).

## Network transmission
Only when you configure an AI provider (such as DeepSeek/OpenAI), chat content is sent directly to **the API endpoint you configured**. DevCodex does not go through any third-party relay server.

## Permissions
- Storage permission: only used to read and write the workspace files you specify
- Network permission: only used to call the AI API you configured

## Deleting data
Uninstalling the app deletes all local data.

A plugin is a JSON tool pack: declare tool names, parameter schemas and HTTP endpoint templates, and the agent can call your own services (Home Assistant, n8n, your own APIs, etc.).\nInstall from a local file, a URL, or by pasting JSON.

No extensions yet. Spec: deploy index.json at the source ([{name,type,desc,url,size}]). type=skill installs a skill Markdown (AI skill); type=plugin installs a plugin JSON (HTTP tool). Once installed the AI can call it in a chat, and you can also manage it on the Plugins / Skills page.

Build an Android APK inside the workspace (Termux toolchain; missing packages auto-installed via pkg). Params project_dir (required, containing AndroidManifest.xml and java/res). Produces a signed output.apk. Suited to Xposed/LSP modules and small utility apps.

Compile native artifacts with Termux clang. Params src_dir (required), out (default out), type (so|ko|o, default so), kernel_dir (required for .ko: kernel source tree path). .so compiles directly; .ko needs a source tree matching the device kernel (otherwise an explanation is returned).
Cross-platform JVM build: javac compile + jar packaging (runs on any JVM). Params src_dir (required), out (default app.jar), main (fully qualified main class, optional).
